findings.motion: Listed among the authors of HB 2739 (primary author not shown on the history page)
findings.note: HB 2739 would let a poll worker accept a driver license or state ID only if the address on it matches the voter-roll address. Bill was left pending in the Elections committee on 2025-04-17 and did not advance.

findings.motion: Listed as a coauthor of HB 5337 (House companion to SB 16)
findings.note: HB 5337 would require a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote and create criminal offenses. It was reported from the Elections committee on 2025-04-28 (5 ayes, 4 nays) and sent to Calendars; the page shows no floor vote.

findings.motion: Listed as a House cosponsor of SB 16
findings.note: SB 16 would require proof of citizenship to register to vote, with a limited federal ballot for voters who cannot supply it, and create criminal offenses. The Senate passed it; the House committee reported it on 2025-05-25 and the page shows no House floor vote.
